claims.claim_ar: جملةُ «إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ» تفيد الحصر والتملك الشامل لما في السماوات والأرض لله تعالى
claims.claim_en: The clause 'Indeed, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth' conveys restriction/total inclusion (hasr/qasr) — i.e. exclusive, comprehensive possession by God.
claims.rhetorical_effect: emphasises the totality and exclusivity of God's ownership to refute any rival claims

claims.source_quote_ar: ألا ترى كيف أسند إليهم الاعتداء ووصفهم به
claims.claim_ar: حرفُ النداء/التحذير «أَلَا» يستعمل لاستدعاء الانتباه والالتفات، أي تحويل مخاطبة السامع وجذب نظره إلى حقيقةٍ مهمة
claims.claim_en: The particle 'Ala' functions to call attention/alert (iltifat), shifting the addressee's focus to an important truth.
claims.rhetorical_effect: grabs attention and frames the following assertions as weighty and certain

claims.claim_ar: تكرارُ «إِنَّ» (في بداية الجملة الأولى والثانية) وعموماً تكرارُ أدوات الاستهلال/التوكيد يعمل كجناس بلاغي يُقوّي الحضور التأكيدي للقول
claims.claim_en: Repetition: the recurrence of 'Inna' (at the start of both clauses) — repetition functions as a badi' device (takrar) to reinforce emphasis; repetition of lead-in particles strengthens certitude.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source passage speaks of repeated conjunctions (e.g. addition of waw) as emphasis; mapping that general observation to the specific repeated particle 'إِنَّ' in this ayah is an inferential step.
claims.rhetorical_effect: intensifies assertion and creates a rhythmic emphasis that underlines the truthfulness of the statements

claims.claim_ar: المقاطع المتتالية في الآية مرصوفة مع فاصلٍ معنوي بين حالتي التأكيد على ملك الله وبيان صدق وعده ثم إشارة إلى جهل أكثر الناس — أي توظيف فصل/وصل لمزيد من التدرج البلاغي
claims.claim_en: Separation/connection (fasl_wasl): the verse uses separated but connected clauses (asserting God's ownership, asserting the truth of God's promise, then noting people's ignorance); the rhetorical use of separation/connection shapes gradual emphasis.
claims.needs_review_reason: The commentator's discussion of 'فصل' concerns separation between states in another context; applying it to the clause-structure of this ayah is plausible but interpretive.
claims.rhetorical_effect: structures the argument: affirmation → confirmation → diagnosis (ignorance), guiding the listener through logical steps

warnings: All source_quote_ar values are taken from the provided Zamakhshari chunks; most quoted commentary discusses rhetorical devices in other verses or in general terms. Mapping those general observations to the specific phrasing of S10:A55 therefore includes some inferential steps (not every source line cites this exact ayah).

For particles like 'أَلَا' and abstract devices such as 'إفادة الحصر' the declared 'root' may be null or lexical (particles do not have triliteral verbal roots); root values are provided where a lexical root is meaningful, otherwise null was used.
